title: Cheap Tupperware copy not safe plastic and REEKED when it arrived. NOT Polypropylene.
text: Cheap Tupperware copy not safe plastic and REEKED when it arrived. NOT Polypropylene.. This isn't #5 Polypropylene (which is a very safe plastic to use), it's NOT marked, and had a VERY strong chemical smell when it arrived.  It's a cheap knockoff of the Tupperware "Pick a Deli" item but I don't trust it's actually food safe.  I'm returning it.  It should be removed from the market.
